[Concave directional derivatives] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0453 1. apph:H.28\group Directional derivatives For a concave function in the interior, directional derivatives are finite, positively homogeneous, concave, and satisfy $-D_{-V}f\ge D_Vf$.
